blurb: Eclectic Sun offers rentals of kayaks, canoes, and stand-up paddleboards at Lake Jocassee. Guests can explore the lake and nearby waterfalls, with equipment launched from their location at Devils Fork State Park. The business also sells snacks, camping supplies, and fishing gear.
extraNote: Devils Fork State Park “Pavillion”, 238 Buckeye Drive, Salem, SC 29676
